description: One row per kiosk mode (12 total: 1 demo/info + 11 troubleshooting devices). Holds each mode's content and config -- which andy_gameboxstate.andy_activedeviceprofile points at the one that's live right now. See power pages/GAME_MODE_PLAN.md §5, §11.

columns.description: Display name, e.g. "Smart Lock", or "Demo / Info" for the non-game row.
URL slug -- matches /kiosk/<slug> and the telemetry deviceSlug field.
No for the demo/info row -- tells win-detection and Copilot-agent wiring to skip that page.
Optional intro/troubleshooting copy, if not hardcoded in the page.
Which Copilot Studio topic this device invokes -- null for the demo page.
Which control-panel layout renders this device -- see tables/choices/andy_layout.json.
